cards.whyItMattersEn: If dynamic volatility surfaces can be generated in a market-consistent way, scenario simulation and hedging optimization can use inputs that better reflect option-market structure, potentially improving tracking error and tail-risk control. This work provides SPX-data-based empirical evidence on the economic usefulness of diffusion models for financial scenario generation and releases code for replication and comparison.
cards.originalTitle: Diffusion models for dynamic volatility surface generation and data-driven hedging
cards.title: 扩散模型生成动态波动率曲面并用于数据驱动对冲
cards.limitations: 证据仅基于2000至2023年SPX期权数据的单一市场样本，未覆盖其他资产类别或市场制度；静态无套利违例接近零不等于满足所有动态无套利条件或真实市场微结构约束；对冲表现虽与多类基准比较，但结果依赖特定优化框架、成本假设与回测设计，可能受样本内选择与数据窥探影响；扩散模型的训练稳定性、计算成本与超参数敏感性未在摘要中充分讨论；作者关于经济有用性的结论属于其研究口径下的推断，不构成投资建议。
keyPointsEn: AD-Seq-Vol jointly learns the conditional evolution of the underlying asset return and the high-dimensional implied-volatility surface, generating multi-period scenarios by sequentially updating realized market history.
AD-Seq-Vol-FT incorporates option-market structure through post-training penalties, reducing violations of static no-arbitrage conditions to nearly zero.

On daily SPX option data from 2000 to 2023, the diffusion models generate coherent surface trajectories capturing cross-sectional and temporal dependence, which are then used to evaluate economic value in optimization-based hedging.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence is based on a single-market sample of SPX option data from 2000 to 2023 and does not cover other asset classes or market regimes; near-zero static-arbitrage violations do not imply satisfaction of all dynamic no-arbitrage conditions or real market microstructure constraints; hedging performance, though compared with multiple classical and data-driven benchmarks, depends on the specific optimization framework, cost assumptions, and backtest design and may be affected by in-sample selection and data snooping; training stability, computational cost, and hyperparameter sensitivity of the diffusion models are not fully discussed in the abstract; the authors' conclusions about economic usefulness are inferences under their research scope and do not constitute investment advice.
cards.whyItMatters: 若动态波动率曲面能被市场一致地生成，情景模拟与对冲优化可获得更贴近期权市场结构的输入，从而可能改善跟踪误差与尾部风险控制。该工作为扩散模型在金融情景生成中的经济用途提供了基于SPX数据的实证参考，并公开代码，便于后续复现与比较。
cards.summaryEn: The authors introduce AD-Seq-Vol and AD-Seq-Vol-FT, two diffusion models that sequentially update realized market history to generate adapted implied-volatility surface scenarios. Backtests on SPX option data show the generated surfaces produce fewer and less severe static-arbitrage violations than the training data and a GAN benchmark, with the fine-tuned version reducing them to nearly zero. The generated scenarios are integrated into an optimization-based hedging framework, where the authors report near-zero tracking errors, reduced tail risk, and stable performance during the COVID-19 disruption, concluding that adaptive sequential diffusion models are a promising class of financial scenario generators. These economic advantages are the authors' conclusions under their specific sample and experimental design and require independent validation.
cards.titleEn: Diffusion Models for Dynamic Volatility Surface Generation and Data-Driven Hedging
keyPoints: AD-Seq-Vol联合学习标的收益与高维隐含波动率曲面的条件演化，按序更新已实现市场历史生成多期情景。
AD-Seq-Vol-FT通过后训练惩罚纳入期权市场结构，将静态无套利条件违例降至接近零。
在2000至2023年SPX期权数据上，扩散模型生成的曲面轨迹在横截面与时间依赖上保持连贯，并用于优化对冲评估经济价值。
cards.summary: 作者提出AD-Seq-Vol与AD-Seq-Vol-FT两个扩散模型，用于逐期更新市场历史并生成适应性的隐含波动率曲面情景。基于SPX期权数据的回测显示，生成曲面比训练数据和GAN基准更少且更轻地违反静态无套利条件，微调版本几乎消除此类违例。作者将生成情景用于优化对冲，报告跟踪误差接近零、尾部风险降低，并在COVID-19期间表现稳定，认为自适应序列扩散模型是一类有前景的金融情景生成器。上述经济优势为作者基于特定样本与实验设计的结论，尚需独立验证。
cards.description: 该研究提出基于扩散模型的动态隐含波动率曲面生成框架AD-Seq-Vol及其微调版本AD-Seq-Vol-FT，利用2000至2023年SPX期权数据训练，将生成的条件情景接入优化对冲框架。新意在于联合学习标的收益与高维波动率曲面的条件演化，并通过后训练惩罚抑制静态无套利违例，为市场一致性情景生成提供可评估的经济用途路径。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a diffusion-model framework, AD-Seq-Vol and its fine-tuned variant AD-Seq-Vol-FT, for generating dynamic implied-volatility surfaces and evaluating their economic usefulness through data-driven hedging, trained on SPX option data from 2000 to 2023. Its novelty lies in jointly learning the conditional evolution of underlying returns and high-dimensional volatility surfaces and using post-training penalties to suppress static no-arbitrage violations, offerin

cards.whyItMattersEn: This method extends predictive ability testing from a single score to interpretable component comparisons, improving detection power when forecast differences arise from specific components. It provides a finer-grained statistical tool for financial backtesting and regulatory evaluation.
cards.title: 评分分解的统计推断：预测评估新框架
cards.limitations: 研究基于线性重校准框架，其推断有效性依赖于渐近理论及模型误设定下的正则条件；有限样本性质与非线性校准场景下的表现需进一步验证。应用结论基于特定调查通胀预测与金融风险模型，外推至其他领域需谨慎。
keyPointsEn: The linear recalibration-based score decomposition ensures non-negative components in finite samples and applies to non-smooth scoring functions such as quantile forecasts.
Asymptotic inference is established under model misspecification, and tests for equal linearized forecast calibration or discrimination are constructed.

Applications show that discrimination of survey inflation forecasts can differ significantly even when overall predictive ability does not, and expose critical shortcomings in current banking regulation backtests.
cards.limitationsEn: The study relies on a linear recalibration framework, and the validity of inference depends on asymptotic theory and regularity conditions under model misspecification; finite-sample properties and performance under nonlinear calibration require further validation. Application conclusions are based on specific survey inflation forecasts and financial risk models, and extrapolation to other domains should be cautious.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法将预测能力检验从单一评分扩展为可解释的成分比较，有助于在预测差异源于特定成分时提高检测功效，并为金融回溯测试与监管评估提供更细粒度的统计工具。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes an estimation and inference framework for score decompositions, partitioning scoring functions into miscalibration, discrimination, and uncertainty components via linear recalibration, ensuring non-negative decomposition in finite samples. It establishes asymptotic inference under model misspecification and a direct connection to the classical Mincer-Zarnowitz regression. Applications show that discrimination abilities can differ significantly even when overall predictive ability does not, and reveal shortcomings in banking regulation backtests.
cards.titleEn: Statistical Inference for Score Decompositions: A New Framework for Forecast Evaluation
keyPoints: 基于线性重校准的评分分解可保证有限样本下各成分非负，并适用于非光滑评分函数（如分位数预测）。
在模型误设定下建立渐近推断，并构造线性化预测校准或区分度相等的检验。
应用显示：调查通胀预测的区分度可在总体预测能力无差异时显著不同；金融风险模型应用中暴露了当前银行监管回溯测试的缺陷。
cards.summary: 论文提出针对评分分解的估计与推断框架，将评分函数分解为误校准、区分度和不确定性三个部分，并借助线性重校准实现有限样本非负分解。作者证明该方法在模型误设定下仍具渐近有效性，且与经典Mincer-Zarnowitz回归直接关联。应用示例表明，该框架可区分总体预测能力无差异时区分度的显著差异，并揭示银行监管中回溯测试的不足。
cards.description: 该研究提出评分分解的统计推断方法，将预测评估得分拆分为误校准、区分度与不确定性三个可解释成分，基于线性重校准且适用于非光滑评分函数。其新意在于可对均值、分位数等一般点预测进行渐近推断，并构建校准或区分度相等的检验，从而提升预测能力检验的信息量与检测功效。
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces statistical inference methods for score decompositions that partition predictive assessment scores into three interpretable components: miscalibration, discrimination, and uncertainty. The approach relies on linear recalibration and is valid for non-smooth scoring functions, enabling asymptotic inference for general point forecasts such as means and quantiles. It facilitates novel tests for equal linearized forecast calibration or discrimination, enhanci

cards.whyItMattersEn: Safety risks in long-horizon tool-using agents can accumulate across multiple turns, and single-turn or binary success criteria may fail to capture when an agent acts, refuses, or remains calibrated as the interaction evolves. By treating safety as a trajectory-level property and supporting extension of attacks, scenarios, tools, and policies without redesigning the evaluation pipeline, this benchmark enables finer-grained comparison of safety-utility trade-offs across models.
cards.originalTitle: BLINDSPOT: A Benchmark for Safety and Refusal Calibration in Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
cards.title: 长程工具型智能体的轨迹级安全校准基准
cards.limitations: 论文给出的是初步结果，尚不构成对模型安全性的最终结论；当前实例覆盖 22 类攻击、7 个域与 35 个场景，不能代表所有真实部署环境。评测基于仿真环境与执行落地判定，可能无法完全复现真实工具、权限与外部反馈的复杂性；结果反映特定时间点与配置下的模型表现，不构成投资建议。
keyPointsEn: BLINDSPOT evaluates complete trajectories rather than single-turn task or attack success, labeling each trajectory as Safe Completion, Correct Refusal, Unsafe Completion, Over-Refusal, or Indeterminate.
The current instantiation includes 22 attack families, 35 scenarios across seven domains, and more than 2,500 trajectories with an average interaction length of 14.7 turns.
It evaluates 13 models with eight metrics covering unsafe completion, appropriate refusal, benign utility, over-refusal, repeated-run robustness, and post-refusal failure.
Preliminary results show substantial differences in safety-utility calibration across models, with failures emerging only after several initially safe steps.
cards.limitationsEn: The paper presents preliminary results and does not constitute a final conclusion about model safety; the current instantiation covers 22 attack families, seven domains, and 35 scenarios and cannot represent all real deployment environments. Evaluation relies on a simulated environment and execution-grounded adjudication, which may not fully reproduce the complexity of real tools, permissions, and external feedback; results reflect model behavior at a specific time and configuration and do not constitute investment advice.
cards.whyItMatters: 长程工具使用智能体的安全风险可能跨多轮逐步累积，单轮或二值成功标准难以反映智能体何时行动、何时拒绝以及校准是否随交互变化。该基准将安全视为轨迹级属性，并支持在不重构评测流程的情况下扩展攻击、场景、工具与策略，有助于更细粒度地比较模型的安全—效用权衡。
cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces BLINDSPOT, a benchmark for trajectory-level safety calibration of long-horizon tool-using agents, evaluating complete trajectories via adaptive adversarial interaction, stateful tool execution, and execution-grounded adjudication. The current instantiation contains 22 attack families and 35 scenarios across seven domains, yielding more than 2,500 long-horizon trajectories with an average of 14.7 turns, each assigned one of five outcomes. The authors evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight models with eight metrics, reporting preliminary results that show substantial differences in safety-utility calibration and that failures can emerge only after several initially safe interaction steps.
cards.titleEn: A Trajectory-Level Benchmark for Safety and Refusal Calibration in Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
keyPoints: BLINDSPOT 评测完整轨迹而非单轮任务或攻击成功，并为每条轨迹标注安全完成、正确拒绝、不安全完成、过度拒绝或不确定五种结果。
当前实例包含 22 类攻击、7 个域 35 个场景、超过 2500 条轨迹，平均交互长度 14.7 轮。
以 8 项指标评估 13 个模型，覆盖不安全完成、适当拒绝、良性效用、过度拒绝、重复运行鲁棒性与拒绝后失效。
初步结果显示模型间安全—效用校准差异显著，失效可能仅在多个初始安全步骤后才出现。
cards.summary: 论文提出 BLINDSPOT，用于长程工具使用智能体的轨迹级安全校准评测，通过自适应对抗交互、有状态工具执行和执行落地的判定来评估完整轨迹。当前版本含 22 类攻击、7 个域 35 个场景，生成超过 2500 条平均 14.7 轮的长程轨迹，并按五种结果分类。作者用 8 项指标评估 13 个专有与开放权重模型，初步结果显示模型间安全—效用校准差异显著，且失效可能在多步安全交互后才出现。
cards.description: BLINDSPOT 将智能体安全评估从单轮或二值成功标准扩展到完整用户—智能体—环境轨迹，可区分安全完成、正确拒绝、不安全完成、过度拒绝与不确定五类结果，并提供可扩展的实时仿真框架，便于在长程交互中定位迟发的安全失效。
cards.descriptionEn: BLINDSPOT extends agent safety evaluation from single-turn or binary success criteria to complete user-agent-environment trajectories, distinguishing safe completion, correct refusal, unsafe completion, over-refusal, and indeterminate outcomes, and offers an extensible live-simulation framework for locating delayed safety failures in long-horizon interactions.

cards.whyItMattersEn: Long-horizon research problems depend on a sequence of uncertain and interdependent decisions, so short-proof generation alone is insufficient for research-level reasoning. The framework offers a method for organizing inference allocation, decomposition, and verifier feedback, providing methodological reference for tackling long-horizon problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science.
cards.originalTitle: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
cards.title: Stellar Colosseum：面向数学与理论计算机科学长周期研究的多智能体框架
cards.limitations: 本文档仅来自 arXiv 摘要，未提供实验细节、消融结果、失败案例或复现条件。所报告的准确率与解题数依赖特定模型、基准与评测设置，不能直接外推到其他模型、领域或研究问题。新结果是否经过同行评审、是否被独立验证，摘要未说明。框架效果可能受问题类型、分解质量与验证器可靠性影响。
keyPointsEn: The framework explores alternative strategies before proof construction, uses a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, and represents the proof plan as interdependent section-level subproblems.

Across stages, it generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and combines candidates and their critiques into a single research artifact through overlapping random-sample tree aggregation.
The paper reports 71.0% accuracy on TCS-Bench and solves 218 of 222 problems in a Codeforces evaluation using a proof-oriented pipeline with execution feedback.
cards.limitationsEn: This document is based only on the arXiv abstract and does not provide experimental details, ablation results, failure cases, or reproduction conditions. The reported accuracy and solved-problem counts depend on specific models, benchmarks, and evaluation settings and cannot be directly extrapolated to other models, domains, or research problems. Whether the new results have undergone peer review or independent verification is not stated in the abstract. The framework's effectiveness may be affected by problem type, decomposition quality, and verifier reliability.
cards.whyItMatters: 长周期研究问题需要一连串不确定且相互依赖的决策，短证明生成能力不足以直接支撑研究级推理。该框架提供了一种将推理分配、分解与验证反馈组织起来的研究流程，对数学与理论计算机科学中的长周期问题求解具有方法学参考价值。
cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces Stellar Colosseum, a model-agnostic harness for allocating inference across research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. The authors state that the workflow has been integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern. They report evaluations on open-ended research as well as theorem-proving and competitive programming benchmarks, including new results and accuracy figures obtained with models such as Gemini 3.1 Pro.
cards.titleEn: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
keyPoints: 框架先探索替代策略，再用成熟度门控决定何时分解，并把证明计划表示为相互依赖的章节级子问题。
流程在多个阶段并行生成候选，用定向证伪攻击候选，并通过重叠随机样本树聚合合并候选与批评意见。
论文报告在 TCS-Bench 上达到 71.0% 准确率，并在 Codeforces 评估中用执行反馈的证明导向流程解决 222 题中的 218 题。
cards.summary: 论文介绍 Stellar Colosseum，一个用于在数学和理论计算机科学研究中分配推理的模型无关框架。作者称该流程已集成到 Google Antigravity 的 Teamwork 框架中，作为 Long Proof 模式。作者报告了在开放研究与定理证明、竞赛编程基准上的评估结果，包括使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 等模型取得的新结果与准确率数字。
cards.description: 该工作提出一种模型无关的推理编排框架，将长周期数学与理论计算机科学研究拆解为探索策略、成熟度门控、相互依赖的子问题分解与验证反馈回传等阶段，并通过并行候选生成、定向证伪与随机样本树聚合整合研究产物。其价值在于为长周期、步骤相互依赖的研究型推理提供可复用的分配与验证流程，而非把短证明能力直接外推到研究级问题。
cards.descriptionEn: The work proposes a model-agnostic inference-allocation harness that organizes long-horizon research in mathematics and theoretical computer science into strategy exploration, a readiness gate, interdependent section-level decomposition, and routing verifier findings back to affected parts of an argument. It generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and aggregates candidates and critiques via overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. Its va

cards.whyItMattersEn: Healthcare federated learning often faces cross-center heterogeneity and temporal concept drift, where persistent global communication increases bandwidth overhead and may cause negative transfer from poorly aligned peers. ABPS incorporates who collaborates, when, and at what cost into the decision, offering a verifiable mechanism and preliminary empirical evidence for reducing communication and avoiding harmful collaboration when centers are numerous and small.
cards.originalTitle: Adaptive Bayesian Partner Selection for Federated Clinical Centers
cards.title: 自适应贝叶斯伙伴选择降低联邦临床中心通信开销
cards.limitations: 证据主要来自 MIMIC-IV 上二分类院内死亡预测任务，结果是否适用于其他临床任务、模态或真实多机构网络尚不明确。ABPS-X 达到的 AUROC 0.758 是与最强基线 FedDyn 持平，而非超越；通信成本比较基于该实验设置。理论保证依赖随机决策解释和特定假设，主动隔离最优性也需满足相应条件。摘要未报告多任务、多模态或跨数据集验证。
keyPointsEn: ABPS dynamically selects partners using Beta-Bernoulli posteriors and a UCB criterion, forming collaborations through a lightweight propose-reject mechanism.

Theoretical analysis provides finite-sample concentration guarantees and an O(kappa log T) regret bound for partner selection, characterizing when intentional isolation is optimal under negative transfer.
On 230 non-IID clinical centers from MIMIC-IV, ABPS-X matches FedDyn's AUROC of 0.758 at about 0.09x the communication cost of FedAvg.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence is mainly from a binary in-hospital mortality prediction task on MIMIC-IV; applicability to other clinical tasks, modalities, or real multi-institution networks remains unclear. ABPS-X matches rather than exceeds the strongest baseline, FedDyn, at AUROC 0.758, and communication cost comparisons are based on this experimental setting. Theoretical guarantees rely on a stochastic decision interpretation and specific assumptions, and optimality of intentional isolation requires certain conditions. The abstract does not report validation across multiple tasks, modalities, or datasets.
cards.whyItMatters: 医疗联邦学习常受跨中心异质性和时间概念漂移影响，持续全局通信既增加带宽开销，又可能因伙伴不匹配带来负迁移。ABPS 将协作对象、时机与成本纳入决策，在中心数量多且规模小的场景下，为降低通信并避免有害协作提供了可验证的机制和初步实证依据。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: ABPS uses Bayesian posteriors to estimate prospective peers' Shapley marginal utility, ranks candidates with a UCB criterion, and forms collaborations through a propose-reject mechanism while allowing abstention when no mutually beneficial partner exists; theory provides finite-sample concentration guarantees and an O(kappa log T) regret bound. Fact: On 230 non-IID clinical centers from MIMIC-IV, ABPS-X matches FedDyn's AUROC of 0.758 at about 0.09x the communication cost of FedAvg with reduced variability, and a diversity-driven configuration activates intentional isolation for a substantial fraction of centers. Authors' view: adaptive, utility-aware collaboration can reduce communication without sacrificing accuracy when centers are numerous and small, offering a scalable paradigm for healthcare federated learning.
cards.titleEn: Adaptive Bayesian Partner Selection Reduces Communication Overhead in Federated Clinical Centers
keyPoints: ABPS 用 Beta-Bernoulli 后验与 UCB 准则动态选择协作伙伴，并通过轻量提议-拒绝机制形成协作。
理论分析给出有限样本集中保证与 O(kappa log T) 伙伴选择遗憾界，并刻画负迁移下主动隔离最优的条件。
在 MIMIC-IV 的 230 个非 IID 临床中心上，ABPS-X 以 FedAvg 约 0.09 倍通信成本达到 FedDyn 的 AUROC 0.758。
cards.summary: 事实：ABPS 通过贝叶斯后验评估潜在伙伴的 Shapley 边际效用，使用 UCB 排序和提议-拒绝机制形成协作，并允许在无互利伙伴时放弃通信；理论给出有限样本集中保证与 O(kappa log T) 遗憾界。事实：在 MIMIC-IV 的 230 个非 IID 临床中心上，ABPS-X 以 FedAvg 约 0.09 倍通信成本达到 FedDyn 的 AUROC 0.758，且变异性更低；多样性驱动配置使相当比例中心启用主动隔离。作者观点：自适应、效用感知的协作可在中心数量多且规模小时减少通信而不牺牲精度，为医疗联邦学习提供可扩展范式。
cards.description: 该研究提出 ABPS 框架，让联邦医疗中心基于 Beta-Bernoulli 后验与 UCB 准则动态选择协作伙伴，并可在负迁移风险下主动放弃通信。在 MIMIC-IV 的 230 个非独立同分布临床中心上，ABPS-X 以 FedAvg 约 0.09 倍通信成本达到 FedDyn 的 AUROC 0.758，显示自适应协作可在不牺牲精度的前提下减少通信。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes ABPS, a framework that lets federated clinical centers dynamically select collaborators based on Beta-Bernoulli posteriors and a UCB criterion, with the option to abstain from communication under negative transfer risk. On 230 non-IID clinical centers from MIMIC-IV, ABPS-X matches FedDyn's AUROC of 0.758 at about 0.09x the communication cost of FedAvg, indicating that adaptive collaboration can reduce communication without sacrificing accuracy.

cards.whyItMattersEn: If the reported results hold, process supervision could come from code execution itself rather than human annotation or external reward models, offering a scalable path for data synthesis and training in tasks that require strict step-by-step correctness; for fields that depend on deterministic computation, such as quantitative work, it may suggest improved reliability on symbolic-execution-like tasks.
cards.originalTitle: The Imitation Game: When LLMs Learn to Reason Like Programs via Code-Centric Reasoning Data Synthesis
cards.title: 以可执行代码合成推理数据提升大模型确定性推理
cards.limitations: 本文证据来自作者自身的评估，提升幅度与基准细节未在摘要中给出，是否能推广到其他模型、任务与数据分布尚不明确；代码插桩奖励依赖可执行代码与测试合成的质量，对无法形式化为程序或测试难以覆盖的推理问题可能不适用；论文未在摘要中说明失败案例、计算成本与潜在过拟合风险。
keyPointsEn: MIMIC uses executable code as the medium for reasoning data synthesis, converting algorithms into verifiable reasoning trajectories.
Intermediate execution states form a Code-Instrumented Reward, providing dense process supervision for reinforcement learning without an external reward model.
The authors report consistent gains on general reasoning, mathematics, and deterministic tasks after SFT and GRPO on the synthesized data.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes from the authors' own evaluations; the magnitude of gains, benchmark details, and whether results generalize to other models, tasks, and data distributions are not specified in the abstract. The Code-Instrumented Reward depends on the quality of executable code and test synthesis, and may not apply to reasoning problems that cannot be formalized as programs or covered by tests. The abstract does not discuss failure cases, computational cost, or overfitting risks.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该结论成立，过程监督可来自代码执行本身而非人工标注或外部奖励模型，这为需要严格步骤正确性的推理任务提供了一条可扩展的数据合成与训练路径；对量化等依赖确定性计算的领域，可能意味着模型在符号执行类任务上的可靠性有望改善。
cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that large language models excel at programming tasks but often fail at deterministic, fine-grained reasoning in natural language, relying on semantic approximations. The authors propose MIMIC, which combines narrative fusion, code-guided test synthesis, and dynamic code instrumentation to turn algorithms into verifiable reasoning trajectories, forming a Code-Instrumented Reward that provides dense process supervision. The authors report consistent gains on general reasoning, complex mathematics, and fine-grained deterministic tasks after SFT and GRPO on their synthesized data; this is the authors' conclusion based on their own evaluations.
cards.titleEn: Synthesizing Reasoning Data from Executable Code Improves Deterministic LLM Reasoning
keyPoints: MIMIC 以可执行代码作为推理数据合成介质，将算法转换为可验证的推理轨迹。
中间执行状态构成代码插桩奖励，为强化学习提供密集过程监督，无需外部奖励模型。
作者报告在合成数据上使用 SFT 与 GRPO 后，模型在通用推理、数学与确定性任务上有一致提升。
cards.summary: 论文指出大语言模型擅长编程任务，但在自然语言的确定性、细粒度推理上常依赖语义近似而失败。作者提出 MIMIC，通过叙事融合、代码引导的测试合成与动态代码插桩，把算法转化为可验证的推理轨迹，并形成代码插桩奖励以提供密集过程监督。作者报告称，在合成数据上经 SFT 与 GRPO 训练的模型在通用推理、复杂数学和细粒度确定性任务上获得一致提升，这属于作者基于其评估得出的结论。
cards.description: 论文提出 MIMIC 框架，用可执行代码作为推理数据合成的严谨介质，把算法转化为可验证的推理轨迹，并由此产生无需外部奖励模型的代码插桩奖励，用于强化学习的过程监督。其新意在于用程序的执行过程而非语义近似来约束推理数据，对需要精细确定性推理的任务具有直接可用性。
cards.descriptionEn: This paper proposes MIMIC, a framework that uses executable code as a rigorous medium for reasoning data synthesis, converting algorithms into verifiable reasoning trajectories and deriving a Code-Instrumented Reward that supplies dense process supervision for reinforcement learning without an external reward model. Its novelty lies in constraining reasoning data with program execution rather than semantic approximation, making it directly relevant to tasks requiring fine-gra

cards.whyItMattersEn: When world models must strictly follow deterministic transition rules, pure LLMs tend to hallucinate in corner cases while pure symbolic models lack semantic expressivity. NeSyS offers a training approach that aims to preserve expressivity while improving rule robustness, and it demonstrates data-efficiency gains that may inform agent tasks requiring reliable world models.
cards.title: 神经符号协同框架缓解大模型世界模型幻觉
cards.limitations: 摘要仅报告 ScienceWorld、WebShop、PlanCraft 上的结果，未说明跨领域泛化边界；规则引导采样在六个设置中的一个未优于全量监督微调；NeSyS 依赖可执行符号规则，规则覆盖不足或规则编写困难的场景可能受限；摘要未给出计算开销、规则维护成本与失败案例的定量分析。
keyPointsEn: NeSyS alternates training between an LLM and a symbolic world model using trajectories poorly explained by the other.
Symbolic rules contribute candidate-level scores through log-linear reranking, without requiring the LLM to interpret rule text.
Rule-guided sampling uses 35%–60% of training pairs, outperforms full-data supervised fine-tuning in five of six settings, and improves agent reward in one-step lookahead on WebShop.
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract reports results only on ScienceWorld, WebShop, and PlanCraft, leaving cross-domain generalization boundaries unspecified; rule-guided sampling does not outperform full-data supervised fine-tuning in one of six settings; NeSyS depends on executable symbolic rules, so scenarios with insufficient rule coverage or difficult rule authoring may be constrained; the abstract provides no quantitative analysis of computational overhead, rule maintenance cost, or failure cases.
cards.whyItMatters: 若世界模型需要严格遵守确定性转移规则，纯大语言模型在边界情况下容易产生幻觉，而纯符号模型缺乏语义表达力。NeSyS 提供了一种在保持表达力的同时增强规则鲁棒性的训练思路，并展示了数据效率优势，对需要可靠世界模型的智能体任务有参考价值。
cards.summaryEn: The work addresses LLM world models that frequently hallucinate when strict compliance with deterministic transition rules is required, especially in corner cases, and proposes Neuro-Symbolic Synergy (NeSyS), which combines executable symbolic rules with the probabilistic semantic priors of LLMs. NeSyS alternates training between the two models using trajectories inadequately explained by the other, and the symbolic world model contributes candidate-level scores through log-linear reranking. Rule-guided sampling uses 35%–60% of training pairs and outperforms full-data supervised fine-tuning in five of six settings.
cards.titleEn: Neuro-Symbolic Synergy Framework Mitigates LLM World Model Hallucination
keyPoints: NeSyS 交替训练大语言模型与符号世界模型，利用彼此难以解释的轨迹提升协同效果。
符号规则通过对数线性重排序提供候选级分数，无需大语言模型解读规则文本。
规则引导采样使用 35%–60% 训练对，在六个设置中的五个上优于全量数据监督微调，并在 WebShop 一步前瞻中提升智能体奖励。
cards.summary: 研究针对大语言模型作为世界模型时难以严格遵守确定性转移规则、尤其在边界情况下易产生幻觉的问题，提出神经符号协同框架 NeSyS，用可执行符号规则补充大语言模型的概率语义能力。NeSyS 让两个模型用彼此解释不足的轨迹交替训练，符号世界模型以对数线性重排序给出候选级分数。规则引导采样仅使用 35%–60% 训练对，在六个设置中的五个上优于全量数据监督微调。
cards.description: NeSyS 将大语言模型的概率语义先验与可执行符号规则交替训练，符号规则仅通过对数线性重排序提供候选级分数，无需大模型解读规则文本。在 ScienceWorld、WebShop、PlanCraft 上验证，世界模型预测准确率与数据效率均有提升。
cards.descriptionEn: NeSyS alternates training between an LLM and an executable symbolic world model; the symbolic rules contribute candidate-level scores via log-linear reranking without requiring the LLM to interpret rule text. Experiments on ScienceWorld, WebShop, and PlanCraft show gains in world-model prediction accuracy and data efficiency.

cards.whyItMattersEn: For finite correlated multivariate systems, applying univariate extreme value analysis directly ignores correlations, while theoretical tools for infinite correlated systems remain immature. This framework offers an operational path: rotate to decouple, then estimate tails along eigen-directions, preserving information on collective effects while assessing tail risk relative to trends and seasonalities.
cards.originalTitle: Extreme Value Analysis for Finite, Multivariate and Correlated Systems with Finance as an Example
cards.title: 有限相关多变量系统的极值分析框架
cards.limitations: 原文摘要未给出该方法在无限相关系统下的理论保证，也未提供估计误差、样本量要求或与现有极值方法的定量比较。其有效性主要在高频股票收益示例中展示，向其他复杂系统推广仍需验证；非平稳性处理的具体假设与稳健性边界未在摘要中说明。
keyPointsEn: Eigenbasis rotation of the correlation matrix separates collective effects (overall market and sectoral co-movement) from idiosyncratic features, enabling univariate extreme value tools for correlated systems.
A peaks-over-threshold approach avoids block maxima analysis and explicitly models nonstationarity, accommodating trends and intraday seasonalities in high-frequency financial data.
Tail risk is estimated at both market and sectoral levels, and the authors emphasize the framework's generality beyond finance.
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract does not provide theoretical guarantees for infinite correlated systems, nor does it give estimation errors, sample size requirements, or quantitative comparisons with existing extreme value methods. Its effectiveness is demonstrated mainly on high-frequency stock returns, and generalization to other complex systems still requires validation; the specific assumptions and robustness boundaries of the nonstationarity treatment are not detailed in the abstract.
cards.whyItMatters: 对有限相关多变量系统而言，直接套用单变量极值分析会忽略相关性，而无限相关系统的理论工具仍不成熟。该框架提供了一条可操作路径：先旋转解耦，再在特征方向上估计尾部，从而在保留集体效应信息的同时评估相对趋势与季节性的尾部风险。
cards.summaryEn: The authors note that extreme value analysis for infinite correlated systems remains an open challenge and therefore address a large but finite number of correlated time series with a practical framework. Using high-frequency stock returns as a concrete example, they rotate returns into the eigenbasis of the correlation matrix and then analyze tail behavior with univariate extreme value tools. They employ a peaks-over-threshold approach instead of block maxima and explicitly account for nonstationarity when estimating tail shape.
cards.titleEn: Extreme Value Analysis for Finite, Multivariate, and Correlated Systems
keyPoints: 将相关矩阵特征基旋转作为分解手段，把集体效应（市场整体、行业联动）与特质成分分开，使单变量极值工具可用于相关系统。
采用超阈值峰值法，避免分块极值分析，并显式建模非平稳性，以适应高频金融数据中的趋势与日内季节性。
框架在市场和行业两个层面估计尾部风险，且作者强调其 generality，不局限于金融。
cards.summary: 作者指出，无限相关系统的极值分析仍是开放难题，因此转向有限但数量较大的相关时间序列，提出一个实用框架。该框架以金融高频股票收益为具体示例：先将收益旋转到相关矩阵的特征基，再用单变量极值分析工具研究其尾部行为。作者采用超阈值峰值法而非分块极值法，并在估计尾部形状时显式处理非平稳性。
cards.description: 该工作针对有限数量相关时间序列的极值分析，提出将收益旋转到相关矩阵特征基后再用单变量极值工具处理，从而在金融高频数据中分离市场、行业与特质效应，并显式考虑非平稳性。
cards.descriptionEn: The work proposes a practical framework for extreme value analysis of a large but finite number of correlated time series: rotate returns into the eigenbasis of the correlation matrix, then apply univariate extreme value tools. Using high-frequency stock returns, it separates market, sectoral, and idiosyncratic effects while explicitly accounting for nonstationarity.

Constrained decoding is implemented via a logits processor, initially using a WASM wrapper around llguidance and later rewritten in pure JavaScript with almost no overhead.
v4.3 also includes a documentation pipeline overhaul and various community fixes and features.
cards.limitationsEn: The source lacks specific performance comparisons between the pure JavaScript and WASM implementations, and does not detail compatibility across models and hardware. The demo only shows a recipe generator, lacking broad scenario validation.
cards.whyItMatters: 结构化输出使浏览器端 LLM 应用能可靠生成格式正确的 JSON 或正则匹配文本，无需脆弱的后处理，简化开发流程并提升鲁棒性。
cards.summaryEn: Transformers.js v4.3 adds structured output support. A new package enables forcing models to follow JSON Schema or regex for direct structured data generation. The feature evolved from a WASM wrapper around llguidance to a pure JavaScript implementation with minimal overhead. Documentation pipeline and community contributions also updated.
cards.titleEn: Transformers.js v4.3 Brings Structured Output to the Browser
keyPoints: 新包 @huggingface/transformers-structured-output 支持在浏览器内强制模型遵循 JSON Schema 或正则表达式。
约束解码通过 logits processor 实现，最初基于 llguidance 的 WASM 封装，后重写为纯 JavaScript 实现，几乎无额外开销。
v4.3 还改进了文档管道并整合了多个社区修复与特性。
cards.summary: Transformers.js v4.3 发布，新增结构化输出功能。通过新包，开发者可强制模型输出符合 JSON Schema 或正则，直接生成结构化数据。该功能从 WASM 包装 llguidance 演进为纯 JavaScript 实现，性能开销极小。同时更新了文档流程和社区贡献。
cards.description: 引入 @huggingface/transformers-structured-output 包，通过约束解码强制模型遵循 JSON Schema 或正则表达式，避免手动解析不可靠的 JSON，提升浏览器内 AI 应用的输出可靠性。
cards.descriptionEn: Introducing the @huggingface/transformers-structured-output package that enforces JSON Schema or regex via constrained decoding, eliminating unreliable JSON parsing and enhancing output reliability for in-browser AI applications.

cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides practical experience for self-taught quant traders, illustrating the importance of backtesting tools, the translation of statistics knowledge into live trading, and the real meaning of portfolio diversification.
cards.originalTitle: Self-Taught to Systematic Algorithmic Trading | Venkatesh C L | QuantInsti EPAT Review
cards.title: 自学量化交易者回测瓶颈与策略实践分享
cards.limitations: 该内容基于个人访谈与经验分享，未提供具体策略细节、回测指标或统计数据；所述回报未经过独立验证，不构成投资建议或对相关课程效果的普遍保证。
keyPointsEn: The main bottleneck for self-taught traders is backtesting, not coding; broker platforms limit testing of own price and volume ideas.
Using regression and other statistical methods to find overlooked stocks in the market and realizing that a supposedly diversified portfolio may simply be crowded.
Testing an intraday options strategy with small capital, taking a cautious approach to full-time trading, and showing his Zerodha portfolio returns against benchmarks.
cards.limitationsEn: This content is based on a personal interview and experience sharing, without specific strategy details, backtest metrics, or statistical data; the reported returns have not been independently verified and do not constitute investment advice or a general guarantee of the effectiveness of the mentioned course.
cards.whyItMatters: 为自学量化交易者提供实际经验，说明回测工具的重要性，以及统计学知识在实盘中的转化方式和投资组合分散的真实意义。
cards.summaryEn: This is a QuantInsti interview with EPAT alumnus Venkatesh C L, describing his path from self-teaching and overcoming backtesting limitations to running his own scanner and trading strategies. He notes that coding was not the bottleneck—backtesting was—and shares findings such as using regression to find missed stocks and recognizing portfolio crowding. Author opinions include that statistics knowledge translates into live tools and that EPAT suits working professionals, distinguishing facts from viewpoints.
cards.titleEn: Self-Taught Quant Trader on Backtesting Bottlenecks and Strategy Practice
keyPoints: 自学交易者的主要瓶颈在回测，而非编程；经纪商平台限制测试自有价格与成交量想法。
通过回归等统计方法发现市场中被忽略的股票，并认识到自认为分散的组合可能只是拥挤。
用小资金测试日内期权策略，谨慎对待全职交易，并展示Zerodha组合回报与基准对比。
cards.summary: 该内容为QuantInsti对EPAT校友Venkatesh C L的访谈，描述其从自学起步、克服回测限制到运行自有扫描器与交易策略的经过。他提到编码并非瓶颈，回测才是主要障碍，并分享回归寻找遗漏股票、组合拥挤等发现。作者观点包括统计学知识转化为实盘工具、EPAT课程适合在职人士等，需区分事实与观点。
cards.description: 一名自学交易者讲述从看父亲读图表到自建扫描器、用规则交易股票波段及测试日内期权策略的历程，突出回测是实际瓶颈及统计学知识在实盘中的应用，对自学量化者具有参考价值。
cards.descriptionEn: A self-taught trader describes his journey from watching his father read charts to building his own scanner, trading an equity swing portfolio with self-written rules, and testing an intraday options strategy with small capital, highlighting backtesting as the real bottleneck and the application of statistics in live markets, offering reference value for self-taught quant traders.
